target_description: Near-term direction of the S&P 500, scored via the SPY proxy.
methodology: Transparent deterministic directional score over price-only features (moving-average trend, damped momentum, mean-reversion z-score, volatility/drawdown regime). Fixed judgement-set weights; no walk-forward-fit coefficients.
calibration_limitations: Confidence is a heuristic strength/coverage gauge (capped at 0.60), not an out-of-sample-calibrated probability. Expected return is damped trailing-horizon momentum, not a calibrated forecast. Price-only inputs; no fundamentals/macro/earnings/sentiment.
